findings: Source acceptance gate: join only Scout-supplied candidate_id and contract/mint identity, with event_at <= available_at <= simulated asof cutoff; require immutable original post or archived capture with source URI and SHA256.
Independent-author and acceleration metrics require multiple timestamp-attested author/post observations; one post or retrospective engagement counter is insufficient.
Manipulation verdict remains UNKNOWN without timestamped author clustering, repeated-post patterns, and contemporaneous engagement observations.
No neutral pool-launch source or contract IDs were supplied for March-May 2023; this is an intake gap, not zero social activity.
R20 progress is diagnostic only; nine completed frames and zero simulated trades do not prove blind detection.
